name: Lisa the ghost witch
source:
Lisa is a ghost witch who appears on Halloween night. If you have sex with her, she gives you good luck for a year.

[From [url=https://little-huntress-team.itch.io/lisa-the-ghost-witch]Itch.io[/url]]
